title: Probing SAM Perturbations Through Statistical Replay
abstract: arXiv:2611.19480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sharpness Aware Minimization (SAM) updates model parameters using gradients evaluated at adversarially perturbed weights, but it remains unclear which aspects of this procedure are sufficient to reproduce its generalization behavior. In our ResNet 18 experiments on CIFAR 10, simple curvature regularizers based on the Hessian trace and largest eigenvalue remain below SAM in validation accuracy, motivating a direct examination of its perturbations. We introduce statistical replay, a diagnostic that summarizes perturbations from reference SAM trajectories using elementwise means and standard deviations over local windows and constructs new perturbations during independent SGD training. Pure replay uses only these summaries, whereas mixed replay adds isotropic Gaussian noise. Pure replay does not reproduce SAM's validation behavior, while mixed replay and pure isotropic perturbations can approach its validation performance at selected scales

translated_title: 通过统计回放探究SAM扰动
translated_abstract: 锐度感知最小化通过在对抗性扰动的权重上评估的梯度来更新模型参数，但目前尚不清楚该过程中的哪些方面足以重现其泛化行为。在我们基于CIFAR-10的ResNet-18实验中，基于Hessian迹和最大特征值的简单曲率正则化器的验证准确率仍低于SAM，这促使我们对其扰动本身进行直接考察。我们引入了“统计回放”这一诊断方法，它使用局部窗口上的逐元素均值和标准差来总结参考SAM轨迹中的扰动，并在独立的SGD训练过程中据此构造新的扰动。纯回放仅使用这些统计摘要，而混合回放则在此基础上额外添加各向同性高斯噪声。实验表明，纯回放无法重现SAM的验证行为，而混合回放和纯各向同性扰动在选定的尺度下可以接近SAM的验证性能。
tldr: 提出统计回放诊断方法，发现SAM扰动的统计摘要（逐元素均值与标准差）不足以复现其验证性能，而叠加各向同性高斯噪声的混合回放在特定尺度下可接近SAM的表现。
en_tdlr: We introduce statistical replay, a diagnostic showing that elementwise statistical summaries of SAM perturbations alone cannot reproduce its validation behavior, while mixed replay with isotropic Gaussian noise can approach SAM's performance at selected perturbation scales.
